name: claude-router
description: Local multi-provider router for Claude Code (model name -> provider + key pool + fallback)

scripts.build: tsc && cd src/web && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run -s build; tsc --watch & node --watch dist/index.js & wait
scripts.smoke:all: npm run -s smoke && npm run -s smoke:admin && npm run -s smoke:guard && npm run -s smoke:routing && npm run -s smoke:capacity && npm run -s smoke:memory
